summary: Radar for 2026-11-23, GLP-1 focus. The strongest new signal is Foundayo (orforglipron). The TGA registered it on 16 Nov and it is reaching Australian pharmacies now. SBS and the Herald Sun ran "first GLP-1 pills here: how do they compare to injections?" stories on 22–23 Nov, and Lilly posted a Foundayo/Zepbound Medicare explainer on 23 Nov. That gives two jobs: a fresh 9-minute "what to expect" script written from the label, and an approved-pill comparison of Foundayo vs the Wegovy pill (the Wegovy pill now takes about 80% of new US oral obesity prescriptions). The best new felt-symptom topic is altered skin sensation (dysesthesia) on semaglutide. Pharmacy Times covered it on 16 and 20 Nov. The Wegovy HD label reports 22% at 7.2 mg vs 6% at 2.4 mg vs 0% on placebo. Few creators have covered it, and people search it as "wegovy skin burning". Keep it semaglutide-only: tirzepatide has no labeled rate. The search-demand formats are refreshed: Months 6+ on tirzepatide, Zepbound vial vs pen and injection sites (IFU only), hair loss and nausea (with the 19 Nov prebiotic-soda pilot RCT as a supporting fact), Serious Risks with UK "when to get urgent help" coverage, and the NAION eye label (an 'association, not causation' expert piece on 23 Nov plus a glaucoma meta-analysis). The next seasonal hook is Christmas on Mounjaro: UK tabloids started "foods to avoid this Christmas" on 21–22 Nov, so the holiday-table slot can roll into December once Thanksgiving ends on 11-27. Context-only items: retatrutide (TRANSCEND-T2D-2 vs Ozempic, and the TRIUMPH-4 knee pain trial in NEJM on 8 Nov) is a pipeline drug, already widely covered and past the 48-hour fast-turn window. The observational studies on stopping GLP-1s and heart risk, nutrient-deficiency anemia, and the SUMMIT heart MRI substudy belong as chapters, not standalone videos. Rejected: compounded-tirzepatide price lists and recalls, NHS GP-funding and pricing stories, retatrutide 'peptide tracker' and gray-market items, and paediatric trials (outside our audience). Verification: Wegovy HD dysesthesia rates are confirmed from FDA/label coverage; Foundayo TGA date and Australian launch confirmed; TRANSCEND-T2D-2 and TRIUMPH-4 figures confirmed; the 'stopping GLP-1s' study is observational and in type 2 diabetes. Reminders: SURPASS-2 Mounjaro vs Ozempic is already made, and Months 2–6 is already live, so neither is proposed again.

Then give the label numbers, name the sensations people describe (burning, tingling, sensitive skin), and close with 'tell your prescriber'. No dose-change advice. Don't extend it to tirzepatide: its label gives no rate, so we only say 'ask your prescriber'. Target long video: Side Effects.
